text:
Alex: heads-up: billing team flagged spike in tenant churn costs coming from a bunch of 10-20s pre-warms. We need an admission change so short-lived reservations don't bloat metering.
Priya: seen it. today we record every reservation start as a billing event. that makes lots of micro-reserves appear as real usage.
Hugo: proposal: collapse and bill by billing_grain_s. forecast emits lease_hint_s and billing_hint_s. operator may return billed_s which is used for billing but must be >= min_bill_window (config, default 15s).
Lina: API sketch: forecast -> POST /v1/admit {token_id, tenant, requested_slots, lease_hint_s, billing_hint_s, shape_hint} 
operator -> 200 {reservation_token, accepted_slots, billed_s, accepted_shape, ready_eta_s, prewarm_id}
Alex: key requirements: idempotency on token_id, HMAC-signed token content, and an explicit stale_accept flag if operator accepts after lease expires.
Grace: telemetry: admission_token_lifecycle{phase="issued|accepted|stale_accepted|released|billed", tenant, pool}. Also emit admission_aggregation_ratio = sum(billed_s)/sum(held_s) to track efficiency.
Hugo: race handling: autoscaler emits token T; if operator doesn't accept within lease_hint_s, autoscaler starts reactive prewarm and marks token ~= rejected. Operator later can accept with stale_accept=true and include prewarm_id that maps to the active prewarm. If prewarm_id matches an active prewarm, operator should return billed_s but not launch another prewarm.
Priya: also allow operator to coalesce overlapping tokens for the same tenant within a coalesce_window_s (config). e.g., multiple 10s tokens overlapping -> billed as one 60s window. This reduces noise but must be documented clearly to avoid surprising cost attribution.
Lina: packing: shape_hint = {cpu:2,mem_gb:4,gpu_frac:0.25} (advisory). operator returns accepted_shape which is authoritative. trace should include both.
Alex: security/abuse: forecast signs token; operator verifies. billing adapter only accepts billed_s when reservation_token signature and prewarm_id reconcile. enforce min_bill_window to prevent tenants from gaming lower billed_s.
Grace: dashboards to add: 1) rate(admission_token_issued[5m]) by tenant 2) histogram(admission_token_held_s) 3) sum(billed_s)/sum(held_s) by tenant 4) prewarm_duplicate_detected{tenant} count.
Hugo: rollout plan: implement token schema + accept endpoint (idempotent) -> internal canary tenants with OPT_OUT_BILLING flag -> enable billed_s reporting to billing pipeline in shadow mode (no charges) for 2 weeks -> enable real billing and monitor aggregation_ratio and tenant complaints -> widen.
Priya: config knobs for infra: min_bill_window_s, coalesce_window_s, default_billing_hint_s, lease_hint_s_max. Allow tenant overrides guarded by quota approvals.
Lina: I'll open API PR with full schema, sample accept flows, and contract for stale_accept semantics. will include examples of token payload and signed header.
Alex: action items: Lina PR, Priya wire signing and config knobs, Hugo patch billing adapter for billed_s and shadow mode, Grace create dashboards/alerts (alert if aggregation_ratio < 0.6 for a tenant), I'll coordinate rollout and billing comms.
orch-bot: noted. will post canary telemetry link when admission_token_issued > 100 for canary tenants.
Grace: quick question: do we allow operator to report billed_s > held_s (credit)? Shouldn't, but sometimes we may want to credit tenant when operator has warmup overlaps.
Priya: only allow billed_s <= held_s; credits handled separately by billing adjustments. don't mix credits into accept response.
Hugo: agreed. keeps accept API simple.
Lina: drafting now, will tag reviewers. aim to land canary by EOD Thursday.
Alex: thanks everyone. this should reduce billing noise and make autoscaler/operator handoff explicit.
Grace: adding dashboard PR after Lina's schema lands.
Priya: ping @orch-bot when canary live so we can trace prewarm_id and stale_accept events.
orch-bot: will notify when canary conditions met.
